shared_upstream_stage.description: One shared telemetry/feature-generation pipeline produces common features and targets before downstream task-specific row filtering.
validity_rules: Sort by subject_id and timestamp_s before lag/rolling/shift
Use only past information for feature creation
Generate targets with subject-local future shift/window

row_eligibility: selected feature columns must be non-null
selected regression target column (preferred_target_col) must be non-null
selected feature columns must be non-null
row must not be removed only because a regression target is missing

missingness_policy: Task-specific row filtering is applied after shared upstream feature generation
Use in-pipeline median imputer at model train/inference time
